newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Absent dock workers disrupt Chittagong port.
newsitem.headline: Absent dock workers disrupt Chittagong port.

text.p: Cargo handling was disrupted at Bangladesh's southeastern Chittagong port on Sunday as dock labourers stayed away despite the withdrawal of a planned boycott by private port users, port officials said.
"The port will function as usual within the next few hours as the port users withdrew their boycott," Captain Zahiruddin Mahmood, Chairman of Chittagong Port Authority (CPA), told Reuters.

The announcement of the withdrawal came early on Sunday after Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina assured the Port User Forum (PUF) that it would be allowed to use its own cargo handling equipment, which has been opposed by the port workers' union.
The PUF comprises stevedores, customs clearing and forwarding agents and shipping agents.
The port officials said the dock workers were away at the moment because of the planned boycott but would return to work soon.
"We have withdrawn the boycott because we believe the prime minister would surely end the resistance from the workers' union against the use of private equipment," said a leader of Port User Forum.
